description: Replaces Dependabot's version updates, with the same rules .github/dependabot.yml had (that file now only shapes Dependabot's security PRs).

Security fixes stay with Dependabot (alerts and security updates on as GitHub settings; dependabot-auto-merge.yml merges its PRs): it updates vulnerable packages that only appear in package-lock.json, which Renovate's own security PRs do not.

Renovate works only Monday from midnight to 6 a.m. New York time and never touches a branch outside that window: a Renovate merge, unlike a Dependabot one, starts deploy.yml at once, and a change under app/ shows every open Fermi the refresh page that cannot be dismissed (AD-24). That is the window the daily deploy used to ship Dependabot's merges in.

packageRules.description: npm (app/): commits as deps(deps) / deps(deps-dev), labelled npm (Dependabot's npm block).
Minor and patch updates travel together, one PR for production and one for development dependencies.

vitest and its companion packages peer-pin each other on an exact version, so a major that arrives as one PR per package can never install. They always travel together, majors included. Listed after the two groups above so it overrides them.
Dependabot never touched package.json overrides: they are hand-kept security floors (exceljs's uuid), and a bump would move them with no person looking.
GitHub Actions: commits as ci(deps), labelled github-actions; minor and patch updates grouped.
A Supabase CLI major (2.x to 3.x) changes the commands deploy.yml and backup.yml run, which no PR check exercises, so it waits for a person.
Node's version lives in app/.node-version, which every workflow reads (node-version-file). The major-only range ('26') is kept, and a new major waits for a person.
